preconditions.name: positive_control_harm_landscape_discriminative
preconditions.description: ARM_REGIME_0p10 (easiest regime; 603k trained a discriminative harm landscape here) must clear harm_eval_range>=0.02 on >=2/3 seeds -- the SAME statistic the diagnostic routes on, measured on the known-positive control. Below-floor => harm-pathway training or the readiness metric is broken (substrate_not_ready_requeue), NOT a regime-difficulty verdict.
preconditions.control: ARM_REGIME_0p10: bridge OFF, full 603k harm-pathway training, easiest proximity_harm=0.10.

preconditions.name: harm_eval_range_has_cross_arm_dynamic_range
preconditions.description: mean harm_eval_range must vary across the difficulty/training cells (spread >= floor) -- else the readout is pinned and the diagnostic is vacuous.

preconditions.name: stage0_forced_feed_lights_zgoal_on_positive_control
preconditions.description: Stage-0 forced supra-threshold benefit lights z_goal (>0.4) on >=2/3 positive-control seeds -- the curriculum is intact.

grid.positive_control_fails: substrate_not_ready_requeue: harm-pathway training/metric broken at easy regime; diagnose harm-pathway optimizer/loss
grid.hard_regime_cell_clears: regime_difficulty_threshold_located: 603q uses the hardest clearing proximity_harm
grid.only_eased_clears: hard_regime_breaks_harm_landscape_use_eased_regime: 603q eases proximity_harm to the hardest clearing cell
grid.nothing_clears: substrate_not_ready_requeue: escalate to /failure-autopsy on harm-pathway training
